releaseNotes:
- A redesigned workspace brings project navigation, Agent conversations, story overview, assets, and script preview together.
- Upgraded adaptation Skills connect character design, episode planning, interactive choices, writing, and review around a continuous story.
- Start importing a project directly with Agent. New projects open their own working folder before you have any material ready.
- Agent conversations stay attached to their projects, with editor context, parallel work, and production progress available in one place.
- Manga production status and recovery remain available while generation is running.
- macOS updates can switch to another download source when the first source fails.
releaseNotesZh:
- 全新工作区统一项目导航、Agent 对话、作品概览、素材与剧本预览。
- 升级后的改编 Skill 围绕连贯故事串起人物设计、分集规划、互动选择、剧本写作与审查。
- 直接与 Agent 开始导入项目；即使还没有素材，也能新建独立工作文件夹后再讨论创作。
- Agent 对话与各自项目保持关联，编辑器上下文、并行工作和生产进度集中可见。
- 漫画生成进行中仍可查看任务状态并继续恢复流程。
- macOS 更新在下载源失败后可自动切换备用源。
